data.title: Forta to Hold AMA on Zoom on August 12th
data.description:
Forta will hold a virtual roundtable on Zoom on August 12th at 14:00 UTC.

The discussion will examine market and counterparty risks alongside smart-contract risk and the lack of institutional frameworks covering all three areas.

Refer to the official tweet by FORT:

Forta 🏰
@FortaNetwork

Virtual roundtable on August 12, 10am ET â­•ï¸

Market and counterparty risk now sit alongside smart contract risk, and few institutions have a framework for both.

Apply👇https://t.co/SfgRrNLdgx pic.twitter.com/JSS3Of8aOs

Aug 06, 2026

FORT Info

Forta is a project that presents a real-time detection network dedicated to the security and operational monitoring of blockchain activity. It ensures protocols and investors can swiftly react to threats, aiming to neutralize them and prevent or at least reduce the loss of funds.

Forta operates through a network of nodes that monitor the blockchain, providing alerts on detected threats. The functioning of these nodes is ensured by a staking mechanism and reward system that incentivizes nodes to perform their tasks correctly. Nodes are required to stake a certain amount of FORT tokens, which can be slashed if they fail to perform their duties correctly. The alerts provided by nodes enable users and protocols to react timely to threats.

The FORT token, an ERC-20 token on the Ethereum network, has multiple uses within the Forta ecosystem. It is used for staking by nodes and detection bots to ensure the economic security of their work. Additionally, FORT holders can delegate their tokens to node pools, enhancing the security of the network and participating in the rewards distribution. A minimum stake of FORT is required for any bot to operate in the network, protecting it from spam and malicious bots. The token also enables holders to participate in governance voting, contributing to the evolution of the Forta project.

data.description:
Polkastarter will distribute POLS on Base to BSC holders and stakers in August.

The allocation will match BSC holdings at a 1:1 ratio, based on a snapshot taken before the price divergence.

Refer to the official tweet by POLS:

Polkastarter
@polkastarter

Hey $POLS holders and stakers on #BSC the time has come to give you something back!

🔵 Airdrop of $POLS on Base at 1:1 of your BSC holdings happening next week

🔵 We have taken a snapshot in time of BSC holders before the price divergence.

🔵 Tokens will be automaticallyâ€¦ pic.twitter.com/Gb0bBMI3QL

Aug 06, 2026

POLS Info

Polkastarter is a decentralized, multichain platform tailored for blockchain projects to raise funds and initiate their ventures. By providing a space for these projects, it enables them to establish multichain token pools, ensuring a streamlined fundraising mechanism while concurrently fostering community growth.

Polkastarter differentiates itself with its “Fixed Swap Pools”, diverging from the conventional Automated Market Maker (AMM) model seen in platforms like Uniswap. Instead of fluctuating prices based on supply and demand, it maintains a consistent token swap rate. Additionally, the platform has amplified its focus on the play-to-earn gaming paradigm with the initiation of the Polkastarter Gaming Guild. Through this, Polkastarter not only bridges GameFi projects and gamers worldwide but also invests in emerging metaverse projects, ensuring that the platform remains at the forefront of the evolving gaming landscape.

Serving as the lifeblood of the Polkastarter platform, the POLS token holds both utility and governance functionalities. Holders are required to possess POLS to partake in IDOs, leveraging their staking power. Beyond this utility aspect, POLS also empowers its holders with governance rights, allowing them to actively influence platform decisions, spanning from feature enhancements to token listings. In line with decentralized principles, Polkastarter’s future roadmap envisions a transition to a comprehensive DAO governance model.

data.title: iA Financial Group Announces the Issuance of a Redemption Notice to Holders of 3.072% Subordinated Debentures due September 24, 2031
data.description:
Further to the approval of the Autorité des marchés financiers (Québec), iA Financial Corporation Inc. (the “Company”) announces that it has sent today to all registered holders of its 3.072% Subordinated Debentures due September 24, 2031 (the “Debentures”) a formal notice and instructions for the redemption of the Debentures. The Company will redeem the Debentures as of September 24, 2026, upon payment of a redemption amount of $1,015.36 for each $1,000 principal amount of Debentures, being equal to par (the “Redemption Price”), together with accrued and unpaid interest thereon to but excluding the date set for redemption in the amount of $15.36. The Redemption Price will be payable upon presentation and surrender of the Debentures called for redemption at Computershare Trust Company of Canada.

About iA Financial Group

iA Financial Group is one of the largest insurance and wealth management groups in Canada, with operations in the United States. Founded in 1892, it is an important Canadian public company and is listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol IAG (common shares).

To learn more about iA Financial Group, you can sign up for our newsletter on our website at ia.ca.

iA Financial Group is a business name and trademark of iA Financial Corporation Inc.
